source: Herron et al. 2020 J Biomech pre-proof (doi 10.1016/j.jbiomech.2020.110077), 26 y.o. model (red), read by eye from the supplied PDF figures
reading_uncertainty: about +/-2 deg for rotations (Fig 3: 10 deg grid; Fig 4: 10-20 deg grid) and +/-5 N for facet force (Fig 5: 20 N grid)
notes: Fig 4 bars are TOTAL range of motion over both directions (flexion+extension, left+right): their level sums equal the Fig 3 two-direction totals (FE 18+29+12+48=107 vs 43+63=106; LB 55 vs 56; AR 101 vs 108). Panel D is therefore flexion+extension, not extension only. Only 1.5 N m panels (D-F) are used. Facet forces (Fig 5): extension = mean of L and R facets; LB and AR = loaded facet, averaged over the left and right cases.
